refugee-camps-to-princeton-u: Google map of the journey of Abass Hassans from Somalia Refugee Camps in Kenya to Princeton University.
earthplacemarks: A large collection of placemarks from all around the world. See multiple satellite views, birds eye view, Google Earth and photo galleries. Get directions to popular locations.

oskope: Visual search assistant. Rich Flash interface allows you to find products on Amazon and eBay, along with related Flickr photos and YouTube videos.
lorestorm: Geekish social site, permitting sharing of feeds, searches, and user posts. Uses the Flickr and YouTube APIs as well as search from Google and Yahoo.
dealzilla: Amazon shopping meets YouTube to bring product trailers and videos mashed up with Amazon product content.
zoogle: Zoogle.in search has lots of categories like content sharing, knowledge, blogs, search engines, and jobs. Zoogle categorizes the search results based on the search sources.
vthumbs: View images and videos of celebrities. A mashup of Flickr and YouTube.
worldflicks: A wiki where people decide which Flickr photos appear on top on the Google Map. Every zoom brings a collection of photos from that area.
blackandwhite: View galleries of black-and-white images. You can view the images with your own tags, or browse the latest or most popular tags.
yes-ebay: YES is a year end summary for eBay Sellers. Get reports for 2006, and 2007 coming soon, that provide information on your sold and bought items. Analyze your performance and see the strengths and weaknesses of your eBay business.
urbandrinks: Select a city and then view happy hour time-lines, reviews, pub crawls, bar locations, and more. Has Portland Oregon, Seattle, Columbus Ohio, and Dallas so far.
yahoo-shop-color: Find products on Yahoo Shopping by color. This feature was initially developed as a mashup during an internal Yahoo Hack Day event in early 2007.
winegeeks: Find maps of wineries found within each wine region.
peppers-and-pollywogs: Kids party entertainer and venue mashup--aggregates photos, videos and reviews, and helps parents find the right kids entertainment within their budgets.
iphonerevu: iPhoneRevu is a map and list view of Yelp Reviews formated for the iPhone. iPhoneRevu is a Yelp front-end for the iPhone.
formula-one-grand-prix-circuit: Displays all Formula One Grand Prix Circuits raced from 1950 to 2007.
nissan-dealer-locator-uk: Find Nissan Dealers in the UK with this mashup.
flight-simulator: Flight Simulator built using Microsoft Virtual Earth maps.
big-huge-labs: Uses Flickr API to do fun stuff with photos. Home of the fd Flickr Toys.
bookmark-cleaner: Bookmark Cleaner helps you keep you del.icio.us or ma.gnolia.com bookmarks clean. It allows searches: A malware and phishing site search A search for cleaning bookmarks with a particular tag and a search for links that no longer exist, aka 404 not found.
stockaholic-dynamic-charts: Stockaholic uses the EditGrid dynamic images to mashup charts from Yahoo Finance. See the Instructions tab to see how to do it.
auctomatic: Tools for optimizing product sales on eBay.
bargain-bits: Price comparison and shopping portal website.
hotels-copacabana-beach: With this GoogleMaps mashup, you can see exactly where your hotel at Copacabana Beach, Brazil would be, with photos, videos, and online reservation directly from the map, ranked from the hotels on the beach to the hostels elsewere in Copacabana.
french-properties: BmyKey is a French real estate, immobilier, mashup. With BmyKey.com, you can easily find a property in France.
rosetta: Site combines the Ning.com platform with Ether.com to create a site where interpreters can find work.
visitor-map-gadget-igoogle-gadget-to-tra: Track recent visitors to your website or blog with this iGoogle gadget which can also be added to any webpage. This gadget uses Google Maps and visitor info is provided by gVisit. A thumbnail grid of Yahoo images are also show for each visitor location.
video-evolved: Generate video playlists of YouTube videos related to your search term and watch the videos back to back. Embed a playlist in your blog.
weather-forecasts-100-hot-cities: A mashup of 100 cities and their weather forecasts from weatherunderground.com. The 100 cities listed are the cities where history shows you are most likely to sweat while there.
anglingatlas: Fishing hotspots, charters and accommodation from around the world on Google Maps. User-generated content. Add your own locations.
northern-colorado-real-estate-site: Northern Colorado real estate site, where you can enter search criteria, such as the maximum price, and then see the search matches mapped.
key-political-races-map: An MSNBC news site. Superimposes a VE map of the US and pushpin symbols that reveal key races during the 2006 election when the mouse is hovered over them.
travelgoop: Google Maps mashup of community submitted hotel prices.
luxurymonterey.com: Real estate mashup of luxury homes and condominiums on the Monterey Peninsula, California. It shows properties listed at $2.9 million and higher. It is updated daily with new listings.
long-island-wineries-map: Uses the Google Maps API for multi point driving directions. The user can select any Long Island winery and generate directions for their wine tour.
i-metro: iMetro helps you find your way in the public transportation systems in over 250 cities, with maps in New York, London, Paris, Madrid, Berlin, Amsterdam and more.
calgary-mapped: Provides a comprehensive list of places in Calgary, organized by categories. Find driving directions, phone numbers, etc. You can also email Map Views to friends.
statr-flickr: Statr for Flickr allows you to track and plot page views statistics for your Flickr account. Graphs are automatically updated on a daily basis and can be linked from external websites.
google-base-and-google-maps-mashup: Search for all the real estate on Google Base with nice integration with Google Maps.
skyshot-maps: Interactive map of The English Riviera, in Torquay Devon. Showing hotels, attractions, historical points of interest, restaurants, pubs and clubs. The site also has video tours and a photo gallery.
realtor-listings-mobile: Search for real estate listings on the go using WAP. From your phone use this 411Sync service with the keyword realtor followed by the zip code. This service is WAP only.
search-oodle-tickets-phone: Search for tickets on Oodle real time on the go using SMS, WAP or Email. Use the keyword oodlet followed by what category tickets you are looking for and the zip code. Within seconds, get a list of all the available tickets.
pictures-bilbao: Pictures of Bilbao, Spain. Click on photo detail to get mapped of location.
capitals-50-states: This is a mashup showing the capitals of the fify states of the United States and the respective state nicknames
imageloop-uploader: New desktop tool for uploading images to ImageLoop. See link on homepage to download .zip file.
springloops: Code collaboration tool for web developers with Basecamp integration. Besides importing people, messaging development log, you can review closed tasks and approve them or not directly on a site, seeing how the work is actually done.
london-office-space: Google Maps API used to simplify and speed searches for office space all over the UK Capital. The entire site is navigable by the map system, which includes postcode integration and images of office buildings.
immoplaza: ImmoPlaza is a new French real estate website, providing a nice geolocalized interface based on Google Maps API. ImmoPlaza is the French equivalent of Trulia or Zillow.

psynchr: psynchr is a Flash based web service to view multiple photosets. You can synchronize multiple photosets on flickr.

baseball-scores-mobile: Track the current status of all MLB games with a single keyword. Simply use SMS or WAP and use keyword scoresmlb.
spotstory: Spotstory is a place where people can share and discover interesting, but often overlooked, locations. Spotstory can be thought of as wiki for place, combined with mapping, photo sharing, social networking, and more.
catalist-homes-california: Real estate search for Southern California. Search for properties meeting specific criteria. Hover over a specific property on the map to reveal address and price.
mydatabus: The MyDataBus service provides a simple way to store, transfer, and share your files online. Data can include photos, videos, and others. Integrates with social tools like Facebook. Integration with Snipshot allows online photo editing.
new-hampshire-physician-affiliations: Shows all the locations of a chosen physician group. Click on an icon to see a list of the physicians at that location.
leawood-crime-mapping: Crime mapping site for Leawood, Kansas.
twittervision: Watch twitters in real time with this live map that dynamically updates to show the latest twitterings.
big-contacts: Full featured commercial service to track contact data, notes and history. Free level allows 500 contacts. Integrates with Skype, S3 and Alexa Thumbnail services.
spendfish: Spendfish uses the Amazon API to find deals on amazon.com.
singapore-hotel-map: Using hotel information from AsiaTravel.com with Google Maps respectively users can sort, view and book Singapore hotels.
technorati-blog-search-yahoo-pipes: Technorati Search sucks in a Technorati search feed for the query of your choice and hands back a JSON object via Yahoo Pipes, ready to insert inline via the usual methods. With implementation details and source code.
flickr-google-maps: A mashup of Google Maps and Flickr. Double click on a country marker to see popular Flickr photos using a simple Ajax interface. Also includes quick links to Wikipedia entries for each country.
cordurl: Cordurl is part maps, part tinyurl, and part social network. Every spot on the globe is represented by a 7-digit geocode. You can subscribe to a geocode to meet your neighbors, find out what's happening in places where you spend time, and share info.
webjam: Webjam is a platform designed to enable creating an unlimited number of modular websites with a community attached to each. Privacy settings for each module. With an AJAX-y drag and drop interface.
dutch-motorcycle-events-calendar: Google map Mashup for dutch motorcycle related events. Features altitude dependant grouping of locations.
randyrandom: For those who like to be inspired by random delicious bookmarks.
tagfrisk: Bookmark all your favourite videos,sightseeing,pictures on a world map.
top-25-releases-itunes: See the top 25 new releases from the iTunes store on mobile phone.
flickr-lightbox-slideshow: Slideshow of most interesting and recent photos from flickr using the Lightbox Ajax tools.
shanklin-explorer: Explore the town of Shanklin on the Isle of Wight. Hotels, businesses, attractions and local information from the Shanklin Directory are combined with Google Maps.
superhighstreet.com: Virtual Tours. Real Streets. Beat the crowds and scroll down world-famous interactive virtual shopping streetscapes like Oxford Street in London.
bebo-mobile: Bebo made mobile by using the keyword bebo and providing your id or your friends id. Within seconds see your all the friends photos. This is a WAP only service.
food-tube: London Restaurants, searchable by Tube station and/or Cuisine, complete with live booking service.
hawkee-technology-network: Social network for techs with a focus on development and computers.
travellerspoint: Map your travels. Create a personalised map and itinerary of your travels, synchronised with travel photography and blog entries through geotagging.
map2tag-french-touch-map: Create maps, share places, tag, bookmark favorite places, add Flickr images and YouTube videos.
sowetouprisings-.com: Documents the June 16th, 1976 uprisings in Soweto, South Africa.
stumblevideo: The terrific StumbleUpon service adds the ability for users to select, rate and discover videos from YouTube, Google Video and MySpace.
mashed-hotels: An interactive worldwide map and directory of hotels, airports and holiday destinations containing over 100,000 listings. Be sure to see their World Capitals Map with hovers that show flags of every country.
fitness-products: Site builds a web cloud based off content which ties directly to a product search using the Amazon Search API.
bronners-my-christmas-wonderland: Christmas lights and decorations in your local neighborhood. Users submit their best Christmas decoration photos and are mapped to a Google map.
montreal-metro-interactive-map: Displays all Montreal subway statons and lines. Markers are placed very accurate. Can display lines separately.
book-sale-scout: Displays book sales on an interactive map.
zillow-to-go: Search Zillow for estimates from your cell phone using SMS, WAP and Email. Configure alerts and get notified real time as estimates change. Simply use the keyword zillow and provide the address of the property.
eppraisal.com: A real estate site that gives you quick and easy access to information on any property in the US. eppraisal.com data is updated daily and pulls from a database of about 70 million homes. Integrated maps and estimated home valuations.
about-nokia: A web site about Nokia that use Google Maps, Search and Video APIs.
mate-matcher: Chart your love compatibility with up to five potential mates.
early-miser: Early Miser is a mashup built on top of Shopping.com, Yahoo Shopping, Amazon, and Ebay. It offer comparison shopping, custom product lists, custom product feeds and tagging.
live-search-opml-generator: Helps users find RSS feeds and autogenerates OPML files. Uses Windows Live Search API. Facilitates selecting feeds from root weblogs or comments feeds per user selection with support for international markets.

bettertrolley: This Google Maps transit mashup takes an independent ride-guide for the San Diego Trolley and mashes it up with Google Maps.
zoomclouds: An auto-tagging service that allows sites to add their own tag clouds.
create-map-korea: Korean mashup with Naver maps and Google satellite photos.
nfl-fan-mapping-site: Create and share maps to places near your favorite NFL stadium, including tailgates, restaurants, clubs, and seats.
airport-parking: A single place to find everything you need when rushing to the airport and need parking. Find out which airport parking facility is closest to you or to the airport, which is cheapest.
mileguru: A free frequent-flyer mileage and point tracking site on the internet focused solely on tracking and managing rewards. Tools and services to make managing and redeeming miles and points easier.
splashr: Choose from over 20 creative styles for presenting your Flickr photos. Interesting variety. Creates clean urls for bookmarking and sharing.
wap-based-image-search: Search for Photos and Images on Flickr, Yahoo, Riya, Webshots and even News right from a WAP capable phone.

cute-overload-photos-phones: This is a mashups of Cute Overload photos and 411Sync Mobile API. Using the search keyword cuteoverload, you can view these photos on WAP capable phones.

currency-conversion-mobile-phone: Currency Conversion gives exchange rates between 2 currencies by cell phone. Via WAP, SMS and Email.

licketytrip-vacation-rentals: Last-minute vacation rental listings. All properties available in the next two weeks. Browse listings on a Google Map.

supinfo-schools: Showing Supinfo, a graduate school of computer science, in different cities in France, China, Canada and the UK.

boston-brunch-map: Browse Boston brunch choices via Google Map.
uk-schools-map: Comprehensive map of UK schools with comparisons of student scores and search capabilities. Marker drill-down brings you to Dept of Education and Skills site details.
overheard: A meta site bringing in the latest funny things people have overheard from a range of sites into one place, along with relevant images and blog links.

bbc-news-map: See where the latest news is happening in the UK.

los-taco-trucks-unitos: A Google Map for when you need to find a taco truck in Seattle.

habitamos-maps: Habitamos Maps combines postings from Habitamos with Google Maps satellite pictures to show a houses and apartments for sale or to rent (Spain). Warning: slow from US.
